table.retrieve:
SELECT customername='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcd'  ,   
			itemname= purorderdetail.remarks,
		itemalias=item.customicode,
		suppaddress1=(select address1 from supplier where supplier.suppcode=purorderheader.suppcode),
		suppaddress2=(select address2 from supplier where supplier.suppcode=purorderheader.suppcode),
		suppphone=(select phone from supplier where supplier.suppcode=purorderheader.suppcode),
		suppfax=(select fax from supplier where supplier.suppcode=purorderheader.suppcode),
		suppcp=(select cp from supplier where supplier.suppcode=purorderheader.suppcode),
		remarks=PurOrderHeader.Remarks,
         PurOrderHeader.POCode,   
         PurOrderHeader.Date,   
         PurOrderDetail.ICode,   
         PurOrderDetail.Qty,   
         Accounts.Name,
			PurOrderDetail.PORowID,
			Manufacturer=(select Manufacturer.name from Manufacturer where Manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
			startdate=PurOrderHeader.startdate,
			enddate=PurOrderHeader.enddate,
			projectiondays=PurOrderheader.Projectionperiod,
			purordercatcode=PurOrderHeader.purordercatcode,
			terms1 =purorderheader.purorderterms1,
			terms2 =purorderheader.purorderterms2,
			terms3 =purorderheader.purorderterms3,
			terms4 =purorderheader.purorderterms4,
			terms5 =purorderheader.purorderterms5,
			terms6 =purorderheader.purorderterms6,
			terms7 =purorderheader.purorderterms7,
			terms8 =purorderheader.purorderterms8
    FROM PurOrderDetail,    
         PurOrderHeader,   
         Accounts, 
         item 
   WHERE ( PurOrderHeader.POCode = PurOrderDetail.POCode ) and  
			( PurOrderDetail.icode = item.icode ) and  
         ( PurOrderHeader.SuppCode = Accounts.AccCode ) and  
         ( ( PurOrderHeader.POCode = :ra_POCode ) )    
ORDER BY
			
PurOrderDetail.PORowID
